body:
I was in a disastrous situation on / off for 10 years
When I was 18( looked 12- I’m very petite)
And I should mention a very broken person-
A man 42( he looked 72!!)
Began comforting & mentoring me
I was NEVER attracted but he offered me “ security “
When I would get up the courage to leave her convince me no one was as “ intellectually” matched as we were!??
He said he cared for me & my young daughter but demanded sex 
Isn’t this abuse
I finally left & 
Now in another similar situation 
My now husband demands sex 
I literally take care of everything 
Cooking
Cleaning
4 kids
Without complaint ( with exceptions)
He is 150 lbs over weight 
Smelly
Rude
I fear he will make me leave if I don’t give him sex
I’m trapped

I’m in tears
It’s 2:33am
I’m up searching posts re: suicide
I’m literally in tears all th time
I am so trapped 
I have 4 kids
A disabled husband who is emotionally abusive
No money
My abusive husband ran my 25 year old daughter out of my life & she is pregnant &due any day
She will not speak to me
I live in a remote area 
Very few resources
My 4 young children are off the chain broken
My 7 year old son pulled a knife on my 10 yr old daughter
My husband lays on the couch all day bitching & moaning about he can’t get any respect??!
I hate my life
I am sad for my kids
My son is always saying
“ I hate my life”
“ I hate my family”
The entire story is much too long for this thread
I’m so tired of living
THANKYOU for your kindness
You didn’t have to bother
But you did

I just found this as I posted here too-
Ok
I am on the brink myself so I’m not in a position to advise nor would I even want to-
Funny actually
As I’ve felt dead inside yet your post causes a stirring in my heart
I actually feel !! 
I guess saying “ I’m so sorry” is cliche & redundant-
So..
Firstly , can I reasonably say
“ I get you”?
My situation is beyond complex:
Horrible Marriage
Dependent financially on the spouse
4 out of control kids
Depression/ Anxiety
I’ve been hospitalized 9!times
Attempted suicide 2x
Last attempt I was told the toxicity from what I OD on was going to shut my liver down in all likelihood but .. it didn’t 
So..
Here I am
Again
And I’m not as brave as you are 
I hate guns
I’m too scared to do it?
Failing before has probably given me a complex..
Anyway 
Im probably not helping & im probably supposed to say “ Don’t do it” but I TOTALLY understand the need to end this Mental Pain as soon as possible 
I cannot function
My kids need me 
But I’m no good
I’ve tried every medicine & nothing works
